subject: Publish failed: offer lint errors / publisher auth missing
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@microsoft.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Azure Marketplace Support <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 19:04:00 -0700
Subject: Offer publish attempt failed — lint errors

Hi Soojin,

We tried to publish the Contoso Retail / Redwood Inference offer you submitted but the marketplace publishing pipeline rejected the payload during the lint/check stage. Summary of failures (attached logs):

- manifest.json schema mismatch: expected schemaVersion "1.1" but found "1.3"
- SKU ids contain underscores (e.g. contoso_premium) — underscores are not allowed for SKU id field
- container image URI uses preview container registry; must be a production image URI
- publisher identity proof not attached / missing signature on DocuSign

I attached the publish-log.txt and a screenshot of the lint errors. Can you please: 1) provide an updated manifest that targets schemaVersion 1.1, 2) normalize SKU ids, and 3) upload the publisher identity proof PDF to the SFTP payload (or include DocuSign link).

Portal link to re-submit: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Marketplace/OfferSubmission/overview/Contoso-Redwood-Offer

If you'd like, we can put this on a quick call — but if you can return a corrected manifest and indicate where the identity proof will live, I can re-run lint immediately.

Thanks,
Lydia Chen
Azure Marketplace Publisher Onboarding
Microsoft Corporation

Attachments: publish-log.txt, screenshot-lint-errs.png
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@microsoft.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 20:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offer publish attempt failed — lint errors

Thanks Lydia — appreciate the quick validation.

Cc'ing Karthik (platform infra) and Marissa (partner lead) to triage. High-level plan:
- Karthik: take ownership of manifest fixes and image URI validation.
- Marissa: coordinate with Contoso DevOps to upload identity proof to SFTP and confirm DocuSign state.
- I will re-submit and follow up with you for a final lint pass.

I'm attaching the current offer-manifest.json here for reference (we'll push an updated copy). Karthik — can you confirm if the SDK we used generated v1.3 by default, and whether downgrading to 1.1 is a simple transformation (or if we should re-run the packaging tool with a flag)? Also please normalize SKU ids to hyphenated style.

Target: corrected manifest and SFTP proof uploaded by tomorrow morning 08:00 PT so Lydia can re-run lint during your window.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Partner Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Attachments: offer-manifest.json
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@microsoft.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 21:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offer publish attempt failed — lint errors

Looping in technical details. Quick summary after a short debug run against our packaging artifacts: 

- The packaging tool we used (marketpack v2.7) emits schemaVersion 1.3 when run against the new template. We can either: (a) run marketpack with --compat=1.1 and re-generate, or (b) post-process the manifest to a 1.1-compatible shape. I'll take option (a) to avoid subtle field differences.

- SKU id normalization: current ids contain underscores. I'll transform contoso_premium -> contoso-premium and contoso_agent -> contoso-agent across the manifest + update the SKU mapping table used by the CI pipeline.

- Container image: CI published a preview image tag. I'll rebuild the container and push to prod container registry (registry.contoso.com/redwood/contoso-llm:stable-20270711) and update the imageUri in the manifest.

Plan: I'll push a corrected offer-manifest.json to the SFTP payload and attach it in this thread by 2027-07-12T08:00:00-07:00.

Command I plan to run:
marketpack package --template marketplace-v1 --compat 1.1 --manifest src/offer.yml --out dist/offer_manifest.json

If anyone wants to review the manifest diff before I upload, I can share the diff snippet.

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik / Soojin — that plan sounds good. A couple of clarifications before you re-submit: 

1) Once you've uploaded the corrected manifest + identity proof to the SFTP folder we will re-run lint. Please include the DocuSign envelope ID in the SFTP payload manifest field (publisherIdentity.docuSignId).

2) If you prefer the portal flow, here's the direct submission URL for the offer (use the same publisher account): https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Marketplace/OfferSubmission/submit/Contoso-Redwood-Offer

3) For publisher verification, please complete the DocuSign envelope if not already done: https://www.docusign.com/contract/abc123 (this is the envelope for Contoso's publisher identity).

I'll keep the support team on standby to re-run the lint once we see the corrected payload. If the lint passes, we'll move the offer to the technical validation queue.

Regards,
Lydia Chen
Azure Marketplace Publisher Onboarding
